title: Intermediate Capstone
introduction: Build a persistent, tested application whose modules and collaboration history explain its design.
learningOutcomes: Select unit and integration tests by risk.

activities.question: Which capstone requirement demonstrates persistence?
options: Saved data remains after the program restarts
activities.explanation: Persistence preserves validated state beyond one process execution.

activities.question: A capstone README should include setup and run instructions.
activities.explanation: Reproducible setup is part of delivering a usable project.

activities.question: Order the delivery evidence.
activities.explanation: Plan, build in working slices, verify the result and evaluate it honestly.
